messages:
alex_w: Quick sync — migration plan for metric identity keys (service_id -> canonical_id). Want to avoid query regressions and preserve cost attribution. TL;DR: short-lived dual-write at edge + query-time fallback + controlled backfill. Thoughts?

maria_g: +1 for dual-write. canary first. Suggest feature flag on obs-proxy and a 2-week canary at 10%.

simon: Concern: a lot of dashboards join on the old key. If we flip ingest suddenly, historical joins will break. need aliasing in query layer for at least 30d.

irene: Also cost attribution: if we canonicalize at the edge we might lose the original tenant fingerprint used for third-party traces. Can we keep legacy_id in the event?

alex_w: Yes — proposal: add field `canonical_id` while keeping `legacy_id` for N days. Add an ingest tag `id_migrated=true` so downstream can opt in. Rollout steps below.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary config applied to obs-proxy/us-west: obs-proxy-1 (route ~10% traffic). CI tests passed.

maria_g: How do aggregators behave? some of them collapse by the first non-null id. We need standardized merge semantics.

simon: We should define precedence: canonical_id > legacy_id for new queries, but keep legacy_id present for migration queries. Also add a query-time enrichment service to resolve legacy->canonical if canonical missing.

irene: For cost accounting, metrics pipeline needs to stamp both ids into billing envelope. If we don't, cost gets misattributed during the backfill window.

alex_w: Proposed playbook (short):
1) Add canonical_id field at edge, dual-write for all requests; preserve legacy_id (60d).
2) Deploy canary obs-proxy flag (10%) — monitor query error & dashboard diffs.
3) Enable alias resolver service in query layer as fallback for joins.
4) Start controlled backfill (throttle to avoid overload) to materialize canonical_id historically.
5) After 30d of low delta, flip query precedence and retire legacy_id after 60d.

Commands to flip canary flag:
```
# feature flag toggle, example
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" \
  https://config.internal/v1/flags/obs-proxy/canonical-id --data '{"enabled":true,"pct":10}'
```

simon: For backfill: use small shards and run a dry-run that computes attribution diffs first. If >0.5% of billing changes we pause.

maria_g: Add synthetic checks: compare 1h rollups pre/post for top 200 services. Alert on >1% variance.

irene: Can we add a header `X-Candidate-Canonical` for trace replayers so downstream SDKs can test without affecting prod attribution?

alex_w: Good idea. We'll add header gated behind SDK env var so experiments possible.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: obs-proxy canary updated to 20% after no regressions in 2h.

alex_w: Ownership: infra-team (simon) owns query fallback + resolver. devex (maria_g) owns canary dashboards and alerts. infra-edge (alex_w) owns ingest change and rollout script. irene will own billing-check diff gating.

maria_g: Quick checklist for rollout PR:
- schema bump docs
- ingest dual-write impl + tests
- query-layer alias resolver + feature flag
- backfill plan + safety limits
- dashboards for top-200 services

simon: I'll open the resolver PR and include a small migration harness.

irene: I'll draft the billing-diff runbook with pause thresholds and contact list.

alex_w: Next sync: tomorrow 11am PT. If anyone finds blocking automation gaps ping me or drop in #eng-platform. :thumbsup:

maria_g: ack.

simon: ack.

irene: ack.

#end of thread
